sentences.en: It took three hours to put the broken toy together.
sentences.zh: 花了三个小时才把那个坏了的玩具拼好。

sentences.en: In Thailand, people use coconuts for food, drinks and toys.
sentences.zh: 在泰国，人们用椰子来做食物、饮料和玩具。

sentences.en: I want a box in which to keep these toys.
sentences.zh: 我想找一个盒子把这些玩具放进去。
